corpusDescription: One ordered process pass per exact clean implementation after known heavy validation jobs stopped: baseline 5d82b9fa23a831986286e8666ca7307c586ef3a1 versus g3 plus transport pruning at 7c3ce2eb0fd952d8d08079ae0d8a5116fab7750c. Same unchanged 78-case timing corpus as the initial pass. No model, prior, or framing tuning followed reserved validation. Timed encode/decode calls include lazy first-use costs; module imports and synchronous asset loading occur before the calls. No repeated statistical experiment or mobile-browser guarantee. Commit, tree, source, formatter, WASM hashes and whole-process peak RSS are recorded; the Node harness can finish work beyond the browser 60-second deadline, which is reported explicitly.
measurement: Every character in the complete URL-serialized Markdown link is counted. Only exact normalized-envelope round trips count as successful. codec is transport metadata; all other schema fields and UTF-16 code units are compared.

variants.timing: One ordered pass including cold first-sample costs; indicative CPU timings, not a statistically repeated latency benchmark.
